properties.name: Great Tang
properties.text: Emperor Taizong's empire, capital Chang'an. The pilgrimage starts and ends here (ch. 9-13, 100).
properties.text_zh: 唐太宗的大唐，都城长安。取经从这里出发，也回到这里（第9–13回、第100回）。

properties.name: Baoxiang
properties.text: Its princess was carried off by the Yellow Robe Monster, the Wolf Star, for thirteen years (ch. 28-31).
properties.text_zh: 公主百花羞被黄袍怪（奎木狼）摄去十三年（第28–31回）。

properties.name: Wuji
properties.text: Its king lay three years drowned in a well while Manjusri's lion ruled in his shape (ch. 36-39).
properties.text_zh: 国王被推入井中三年，文殊的青毛狮子变作他的模样坐了王位（第36–39回）。

properties.name: Cheqi
properties.text: Ruled by three Taoist masters who enslaved the monks, until the contest of magic (ch. 44-46). Placed at Agni (Karashahr), which Xuanzang visited.
properties.text_zh: 三位道士国师当国，和尚沦为苦力，直到斗法（第44–46回）。比附为玄奘经过的阿耆尼国（焉耆）。

properties.name: Western Liang, the Women's Country
properties.text: A kingdom of women whose queen offered Tripitaka her throne (ch. 53-54). Placed at the Eastern Women's Kingdom of the Record of the Western Regions.
properties.text_zh: 女儿国，女王愿以一国之富招唐僧为王（第53–54回）。比附为《大唐西域记》所载东女国。

properties.name: Jisai
properties.text: Its pagoda's relic was stolen by the nine-headed bird of Green Wave Lake (ch. 62-63).
properties.text_zh: 金光寺宝塔佛宝被碧波潭九头虫盗走（第62–63回）。

properties.name: Zhuzi
properties.text: Its king pined three years for a queen taken by Guanyin's golden-haired hou (ch. 68-71).
properties.text_zh: 国王因金圣宫娘娘被观音坐骑金毛犼摄去，相思成病三年（第68–71回）。

properties.name: Lion-Camel Kingdom
properties.text: A kingdom eaten whole by the Great Peng five hundred years before the pilgrims came (ch. 74-77).
properties.text_zh: 五百年前被大鹏金翅雕吃尽满城君臣百姓，成了妖城（第74–77回）。

properties.name: Bhiksu
properties.text: A deer spirit, the king's father-in-law, demanded 1,111 children's hearts (ch. 78-79).
properties.text_zh: 国丈白鹿精要用一千一百一十一个小儿心肝做药引（第78–79回）。

properties.name: The Law-Destroying Kingdom
properties.text: Its king had killed 9,996 monks before Wukong shaved the whole court bald (ch. 84).
properties.text_zh: 国王已杀九千九百九十六个和尚，被悟空一夜剃光满朝头发，改名钦法国（第84回）。

properties.name: India
properties.text: Its princess was replaced by the Jade Rabbit (ch. 93-95). Placed at Kanyakubja, Harsha's capital.
properties.text_zh: 公主被月宫玉兔顶替（第93–95回）。比附为戒日王都城曲女城。
